data.summary: 4 issues found, 6 checks passed: 2 need human judgement (Board-resolution signatory is a current director; Beneficial owners above 10% identified and KYC'd) and 2 the merchant can fix (Bank account holder matches legal name; Address consistent (registered office / principal place / application)). Escalate to a KAM decision.

findings.title: Board-resolution signatory is a current director
findings.explanation: Ravish Sahay is not a current director (MCA: Anil Sharma, Priya Sharma). The resolution itself is signed by Anil Sharma, Priya Sharma. A human must judge whether this is a valid delegation of authority.
findings.recommendedAction: Human review: escalate to a KAM decision

findings.title: Beneficial owners above 10% identified and KYC'd
findings.explanation: Priya Sharma 30% direct has no KYC on file; Rakesh Sharma 18% effective (via Sharma Holdings LLP: 60% of its 30%) has no KYC on file; Meera Sharma 12% effective (via Sharma Holdings LLP: 40% of its 30%) has no KYC on file. 2 hidden behind a corporate shareholder.
findings.recommendedAction: Human review: escalate to a KAM decision

findings.title: Bank account holder matches legal name
findings.explanation: The cheque pre-prints “Sharma Foods” but the legal name is “Sharma Foods Private Limited” (the company suffix is missing; the holder name must match exactly).
findings.recommendedAction: Ask the merchant to correct or re-upload

findings.title: Address consistent (registered office / principal place / application)
findings.sourceValue: 12 Mahatma Gandhi Marg, Navi Mumbai - 400703, Maharashtra
findings.explanation: Address drift: the GST certificate’s principal place says “12 Mahatma Gandhi Marg, Navi Mumbai - 400703, Maharashtra” but the application says “12 MG Road, Mumbai - 400001, Maharashtra”.
findings.recommendedAction: Ask the merchant to correct or re-upload
